# Keep keyboard focus accessible when an expired draft notice disappears

## What & Why
The expiry announcement is covered, but the keyboard destination after a recovery control is removed at the deadline is not explicitly protected. A focus regression could leave keyboard users without a usable next target.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity expiry after navigation announce that the draft is no longer available.
- Focus moves to a visible, meaningful control instead of a detached recovery button.
- No answer or opportunity form opens during expiry.
